subject: Index Federation: partner cadence & GTM sprint
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: partnerships@pinecone.io, alliances@semi.technology, pgvector-team@pgvector.org
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: Index Federation: partner cadence & GTM sprint

Hi all —

Thanks for hopping on the intro call last week. Per our notes, Redwood is proposing a short cross-partner sprint to validate a lightweight "index federation" pattern that lets customers route similarity queries across a primary vector DB + S3 cold store fallthrough. Goal: technical proof (interop end-to-end) + one co-marketable reference.

Proposed 3-week plan (high level):
- Week 0: alignment — data formats, auth patterns, sample datasets (1 customer PoC)
- Week 1: adapters & fallback — shared connector spec + runbook for prefix/KV routing
- Week 2: scale test & co-demo — perf matrix, failure scenarios, commercial framing

As attachments: scope doc and a draft commercials worksheet. Quick asks from our side:
1) Can Pinecone confirm support for streaming query-teardown hooks (to handle partial fallthrough)?
2) Weaviate — can the cluster-side plugin accept an S3 URI signer pattern for cold fetch?
3) pgvector — do you have an opinion on minimal SQL/schema to preserve metadata when materializing vectors to S3?

Please reply with availability for a 30–45m kickoff this week and any redlines to the scope attachment.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: index-federation-scope-20271116.pdf, proposed-commercials-sheet.xlsx

From: partnerships@pinecone.io <partnerships@pinecone.io>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: alliances@semi.technology, pgvector-team@pgvector.org, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 12:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Index Federation: partner cadence & GTM sprint

On Tue, Nov 16, 2027 at 09:01 -0800, Markus Klein wrote:
> Thanks for hopping on the intro call last week...

Hi Markus + team —

Pinecone is excited to be part of this. Quick answers:
- streaming query-teardown hooks: we have an experimental hook in our SDKs (Node/Python) that emits an event when a partial candidate set is returned; we can enable it for the PoC environment.
- We can sign S3 URIs but prefer a short-lived token exchange via our proxy to avoid wide ACLs.
- Commercials: we prefer a revenue-split for co-sell leads + a capped trial credit for reference customers.

We are available for a kickoff Thu 2027-11-18 10:00–11:00 PT. Confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.

— Elena Rivera
Partnerships Manager, Pinecone
partnerships@pinecone.io

Attachment: pinecone-infra-notes-brief.txt

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, partnerships@pinecone.io, alliances@semi.technology, pgvector-team@pgvector.org
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 08:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Index Federation: partner cadence & GTM sprint

Team —

Thanks Elena. Quick ops notes from Redwood product & GTM so the kickoff can be focused:
- PoC customer: we'll propose "BeaconHealth" (SMB healthcare) — they already run pgvector + S3 cold store and need a multi-backend query strategy.
- Success criteria (technical): end-to-end 95th p latency within 2x single-store baseline for mixed hot/cold queries + transparent fallback trace in our Console.
- Success criteria (commercial): a one-pager co-sell asset and a joint demo with Pinecone as primary and Weaviate or pgvector as fallthrough.

Marissa, Sergio — please prepare:
- Marissa: partner enablement checklist + initial slide for co-sell asset
- Sergio: draft runbook for router policies (latency vs cost tiers)

I added both attachments (scope + commercials) to the Drive link in metadata.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, partnerships@pinecone.io, alliances@semi.technology
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Index Federation: partner cadence & GTM sprint

Vanessa / team —

Uploading a first-pass co-sell one-pager and an enablement checklist. Highlights:
- Target personas: platform eng, data infra lead, ML infra manager
- Key messages: "consistent inference economics", "graceful degradation", "single API surface"
- Demo script: 6 steps with explicit failure injection to show fallback routing

Notes / asks for partners:
- Pinecone: can we get a short quote about performance expectations for the co-sell one-pager? (1–2 lines)
- Weaviate / pgvector: any short capability callouts you want on the one-pager?

Attachment: partner-onesheet-draft.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior GTM Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: partnerships@pinecone.io <partnerships@pinecone.io>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: alliances@semi.technology, pgvector-team@pgvector.org
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Index Federation: partner cadence & GTM sprint

Markus / Vanessa / Marissa —

Thanks — Pinecone confirms Thu 11/18 10:00 PT for kickoff. Quick inputs before the call:
- Performance quote for one-pager: "Pinecone typically returns top-K similarity results in sub-50ms for 128-d vectors at 1k QPS on our managed offering; fallthrough tuning depends on candidate set size."
- We can provide a small PoC tenancy with logging enabled for the 3-week window; we'll also attach our SDK hook guide to the shared Drive after the meeting.
- Commercials: we'll propose 2 months of promotional credits for the reference customer + a 20/80 lead-split favoring the partner who closed the ARR.

See you on the call.

— Elena Rivera, Pinecone
